import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_67/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_67/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_67/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_67/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_67/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_67/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_67/training_6.csv"
]

# Load all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# According to operation_history: UNION all source tables
# All source tables have the same schema ['air_store_id', 'dow'], so union is valid
union_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the schema and types match the target schema:
# Target schema: ['air_store_id': string, 'dow': integer]
union_df['air_store_id'] = union_df['air_store_id'].astype(str)
union_df['dow'] = union_df['dow'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_67/target_multisource.csv"
union_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
